title: Ramsey graphs: R(4,21) ≥ 254 and R(8,12) ≥ 514
description: Two graphs that improve lower bounds on Ramsey numbers: a 253-vertex graph with no K4 and no independent set of size 21 (R(4,21) ≥ 254), and a 513-vertex graph with no K8 and no independent set of size 12 (R(8,12) ≥ 514). Both extend graphs published by Google Research (google-research/ramsey_number_bounds) by SAT-based vertex extension. Includes the extension code and two independent exact checkers.
